en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the ornate interior of a grand café or restaurant with high decorated ceilings, chandeliers, wall mirrors, wood paneling, and many small tables covered with white cloths and bentwood chairs. A piano is visible toward the back, and a sign reading "Pause" hangs above it. In the lower‑right corner, a caption reads "CAFÉ OPÉRA Unter den Linden 21."
